title: prunus persica var. pyramidalis
intro: Prunus persica var. pyramidalis, commonly known as the dwarf or pyramidal peach, is a variety of the peach tree that is compact in size and produces fruit with a unique, pyramidal shape. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to support cardiovascular health and improve cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Prunus persica var. pyramidalis include its potential to calm the nervous system, improve mood, and reduce stress levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
